canvas.keys.clipboard: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X, Ctrl+V and Ctrl+D copy, cut, paste and duplicate. Paste or drop images and links too.
canvas.keys.connect: C starts a connection from the selected element; choose the target and press Enter.
canvas.keys.edit: Enter edits, Delete removes, double-click the background to add a note.
canvas.keys.group: Ctrl+G groups the selection, Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups it; Alt-click selects one member of a group.
canvas.keys.guides: While you drag, guide lines appear when edges or centres line up with nearby elements, and the element snaps to them (hold Alt to place freely).
canvas.keys.move: Arrow keys move the selected elements (Shift for bigger steps).
canvas.keys.navigate: Tab moves between elements; with the canvas focused, arrow keys move the view.
canvas.keys.outline: The text outline lists every element and connection for screen readers.
canvas.keys.pan: Drag the background (or use two fingers) to move around.
canvas.keys.resize: Alt + arrow keys resize them; drag the bottom-right corner with the pointer.
canvas.keys.select: Space or Shift-click adds to the selection, Shift-drag selects an area, Ctrl+A selects all, Esc clears.
canvas.keys.snap: G turns snapping to the grid on or off (hold Alt while dragging to place freely); L locks or unlocks the selection.
canvas.keys.title: Keyboard
canvas.keys.undo: Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes.
canvas.keys.zoom: + and − zoom, 0 fits everything on screen; Ctrl + wheel or pinch also zoom.
